title: Convention manifest
description: The docs a conventionSources entry with select "manifest" reads, committed to the docs repo and read at the same pinned commit. The Rust engine's parser is the authority; this schema documents the same shape for editors, generators and CI. The loader collapses whitespace in a description before it counts the 300 characters. Unknown keys are ignored, at the top level and in a doc.

schemaVersion.description: The manifest format. This loader reads 1.

docs.description: The docs, in any order. The first entry for a path wins.

path.description: A file in the docs repo, from its root. Any extension: the doc is loaded verbatim. With the source's root set, a path outside it is not loaded.

description.description: The doc's line in the on-demand menu. Each run of whitespace becomes one space and the ends are trimmed; the 300 limit is counted in UTF-16 code units after that collapse.

type.description: A doc of type "convention" that matches no changed path is still offered in the menu.

covers.description: The repo paths the doc describes: an entry ending in / holds every path under it, one with *, ? or { is a glob, any other must equal the path. A list applies to every consumer; an object of lists is read through the source's consumer. Without covers a doc is reached only through include.
